# Spec Template

## Overview
Describe the requested capability in plain language.

## Goals
- Primary outcome
- Success criteria

## Non-Goals
- Explicitly excluded work

## Current State
- Existing behavior
- Constraints or dependencies

## Proposed Change
- Behavior changes
- Interface or schema changes
- Data flow updates

## Edge Cases
- Failure modes
- Unknowns or assumptions

## Acceptance Criteria
- Observable outcomes that define completion
